memory_objects.content: The data processing pipeline employs a top-down approach. A `Context Planner` first creates fixed-size chunks (e.g., 80 lines). A `Segment Agent` then identifies topical `Segments` within these chunks, from which `Idea Units` (viewpoints) are finally extracted. This process includes a fallback mechanism that uses the raw text of any missed lines to ensure 100% transcript coverage, tagging these outputs as lower quality.
